description_en: Updates the title or archive status of a specified session
description_zh: 更新指定会话的标题或归档状态
name: UpdateCopilotSession

parameters.help_en: The session title. The length is 1 to 255 characters
parameters.help_zh: 会话标题，长度为 1～255 个字符
parameters.name: name

code.description_en: The returned status code. Success indicates that the request is successful. Other values indicate that the request failed
code.description_zh: 返回状态码。Success 表示请求成功；其他值表示请求失败

activeTurn.description_en: The summary of the execution that currently occupies the session. This field is empty when no active execution is in progress. An execution with an unknown outcome may still occupy the session
activeTurn.description_zh: 当前占用会话的执行摘要。无活动执行时为空；结果未知的执行仍可能占用会话

createdAt.description_en: The creation time of the current execution turn. The time is in the ISO 8601 format
createdAt.description_zh: 本轮执行创建时间，采用 ISO 8601 格式

finishedAt.description_en: The end time of the execution. The time is in the ISO 8601 format. This field is empty if the execution has not ended
finishedAt.description_zh: 执行结束时间，采用 ISO 8601 格式。尚未结束时为空

inputTokens.description_en: The cumulative number of input tokens for the current turn. This is not the incremental usage for the current event
inputTokens.description_zh: 本轮累计输入 Token 数，不是当前事件的增量用量

outputTokens.description_en: The cumulative number of output tokens for the current turn
outputTokens.description_zh: 本轮累计输出 Token 数

pendingInputId.description_en: The ID of the form that is currently waiting for user input. It is used when submitting user input. This field is empty when no form is pending
pendingInputId.description_zh: 当前等待用户填写的表单 ID。提交用户输入时使用；没有待填写表单时为空

status.description_en: The execution status. Valid values: running (in progress), waiting_input (waiting for user input), cancelling (cancelling), completed (completed), failed (failed), cancelled (cancelled), and outcome_unknown (outcome unknown, may still occupy the session, and should not be automatically rerun)
status.description_zh: 执行状态。running：执行中；waiting_input：等待用户输入；cancelling：正在取消；completed：已完成；failed：失败；cancelled：已取消；outcome_unknown：结果未知，仍可能占用会话，不应自动重跑

turnId.description_en: The ID of the current execution turn. It is used to submit user input, reconnect, or stop the execution
turnId.description_zh: 本轮执行 ID，用于提交用户输入、重新连接或停止执行

updatedAt.description_en: The last update time of the current execution turn. The time is in the ISO 8601 format
updatedAt.description_zh: 本轮执行最近更新时间，采用 ISO 8601 格式

createdAt.description_en: The creation time of the session. The time is in the ISO 8601 format
createdAt.description_zh: 会话创建时间，采用 ISO 8601 格式

cursor.description_en: The latest persisted event cursor for the current session, returned as a decimal string. The value is 0 when no events exist. This value does not represent the position consumed by the client
cursor.description_zh: 当前会话最新持久化事件游标，以十进制字符串返回。无事件时为 0。该值不是客户端已消费的位置

lastTurn.description_en: The summary of the most recent execution. This field is empty if no execution has ever occurred. If the most recent execution has not ended, this field may point to the same execution as activeTurn
lastTurn.description_zh: 最近一次执行的摘要。从未执行时为空；最近执行尚未结束时，可以与 activeTurn 指向同一执行

createdAt.description_en: The creation time of the current execution turn. The time is in the ISO 8601 format
createdAt.description_zh: 本轮执行创建时间，采用 ISO 8601 格式

finishedAt.description_en: The end time of the execution. The time is in the ISO 8601 format. This field is empty if the execution has not ended
finishedAt.description_zh: 执行结束时间，采用 ISO 8601 格式。尚未结束时为空

inputTokens.description_en: The cumulative number of input tokens for the current turn. This is not the incremental usage for the current event
inputTokens.description_zh: 本轮累计输入 Token 数，不是当前事件的增量用量

outputTokens.description_en: The cumulative number of output tokens for the current turn
outputTokens.description_zh: 本轮累计输出 Token 数

pendingInputId.description_en: The ID of the form that is currently waiting for user input. It is used when submitting user input. This field is empty when no form is pending
pendingInputId.description_zh: 当前等待用户填写的表单 ID。提交用户输入时使用；没有待填写表单时为空

status.description_en: The execution status. Valid values: running (in progress), waiting_input (waiting for user input), cancelling (cancelling), completed (completed), failed (failed), cancelled (cancelled), and outcome_unknown (outcome unknown, may still occupy the session, and should not be automatically rerun)
status.description_zh: 执行状态。running：执行中；waiting_input：等待用户输入；cancelling：正在取消；completed：已完成；failed：失败；cancelled：已取消；outcome_unknown：结果未知，仍可能占用会话，不应自动重跑

turnId.description_en: The ID of the current execution turn. It is used to submit user input, reconnect, or stop the execution
turnId.description_zh: 本轮执行 ID，用于提交用户输入、重新连接或停止执行

updatedAt.description_en: The last update time of the current execution turn. The time is in the ISO 8601 format
updatedAt.description_zh: 本轮执行最近更新时间，采用 ISO 8601 格式

scheduledTask.description_en: The snapshot information when the scheduled task is triggered. This is returned only for scheduled task sessions and is empty for sessions from other sources. Subsequent renaming or deletion of the task does not change the historical snapshot
scheduledTask.description_zh: 定时任务触发时的快照信息。仅定时任务会话返回，其他来源会话为空。任务后续改名或删除不改变历史快照

runId.description_en: The ID of this scheduled execution. Multiple triggers of the same scheduled task use different runIds
runId.description_zh: 本次调度执行 ID。同一定时任务的多次触发使用不同的 runId

scheduledAt.description_en: The scheduled trigger time. The time is in the ISO 8601 format with a time zone. This field is empty when no record exists
scheduledAt.description_zh: 计划触发时间，采用携带时区的 ISO 8601 格式。无记录时为空

startedAt.description_en: The time when Copilot starts processing this schedule. The time is in the ISO 8601 format with a time zone. This is not the time when the model outputs the first token
startedAt.description_zh: Copilot 开始处理本次调度的时间，采用携带时区的 ISO 8601 格式。不是模型首字输出时间

taskId.description_en: The ID of the associated scheduled task

taskName.description_en: The name of the scheduled task at the time of this trigger
taskName.description_zh: 本次触发时的定时任务名称

timezone.description_en: The scheduling time zone of the scheduled task, such as Asia/Shanghai
timezone.description_zh: 定时任务的调度时区，例如 Asia/Shanghai

sessionType.description_en: The source of the session creation. Valid values: openapi (proactive call), cron (scheduled task), im_dingtalk (DingTalk), im_feishu (Lark), and alert (alert). This is determined by the server, and subsequent follow-up questions do not change the source
sessionType.description_zh: 会话创建来源。openapi：主动调用；cron：定时任务；im_dingtalk：钉钉；im_feishu：飞书；alert：告警。由服务端确定，后续追问不改变来源

status.description_en: The session status. Valid values: active (not archived) and archived (archived). This field does not indicate whether the execution has ended
status.description_zh: 会话状态。active：未归档；archived：已归档。该字段不表示执行是否结束

updatedAt.description_en: The last update time of the session. The time is in the ISO 8601 format
updatedAt.description_zh: 会话最近更新时间，采用 ISO 8601 格式

message.description_en: The error message. If the code is Success, this field is empty. Otherwise, this field contains the request error message
message.description_zh: 错误信息。如果 code 为 Success，则本字段为空；否则本字段包含请求错误信息

requestId.description_en: The request ID. It can be used for end-to-end diagnostics
requestId.description_zh: 请求 ID，可用于全链路诊断
